notes: www.squadstack.com/careers redirects to www.squadstack.ai/careers, a Webflow page that fetches the complete array from https://careers.squadstack.com/webflow.php (21 rows) and renders the cards and detail links itself. The page has two selects, All Teams and All Locations, that filter that array client-side; the feed endpoint accepts no filter or keyword parameters.
